description: This file defines the CommentsController class, which handles HTTP requests related to comments on articles in an ASP.NET Core web application. It includes actions for creating, retrieving, and deleting comments, utilizing MediatR for command/query dispatching.

classes.name: CommentsController
classes.description: An ASP.NET Core controller managing comment-related endpoints for articles.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST to create a new comment on an article identified by slug.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET to retrieve comments for an article identified by slug.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Handles HTTP DELETE to remove a specific comment by id for an article.
